items.question: How much do windows and doors cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the system, dimensions, and configuration. Send us the parameters and we’ll prepare an accurate quote for your project.

items.question: How long does production take?
items.answer: On average 2 to 6 weeks depending on the complexity of the project.

items.question: Do you handle installation?
items.answer: Yes — our team delivers professional turnkey installation with a workmanship warranty.

items.question: What warranty do you offer?
items.answer: Profiles and hardware from 5 years, glazing up to 10 years.

items.question: Can I order a custom design?
items.answer: Yes. We work with non-standard shapes, colours and configurations tailored to your project.

Tawk.to LLC (USA) — live chat provider. If you accept all cookies, the chat widget is enabled to talk to an operator. Tawk.to acts as a data processor. More info: https://www.tawk.to/data-protection/GDPR/

sections.title: Retention period

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: As a data subject, you are entitled to:
items: lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, www.aepd.es) if you consider the processing breaches the applicable rules

sections.title: How to exercise your rights
sections.body: You can exercise any of these rights by emailing albaventanas@gmail.com, clearly stating which right you wish to exercise and attaching a copy of an ID document. We will respond within one month.

sections.title: Security measures

cookieBanner.title: We use cookies
cookieBanner.description: This site uses strictly necessary technical cookies (language, consent choice, modal state). If you accept all, we also enable live chat (Tawk.to) so you can talk to an operator. You can decline at any time.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.intro: This Policy explains what cookies and other local-storage mechanisms are used on the Alba Ventanas SL website, for what purpose and how you can manage them.
cookiesPage.whatBody: A cookie is a small file downloaded to your device when you visit a website. It allows the site to remember information about your visit. Alongside cookies we also use the browser local storage (localStorage), which serves a similar purpose.
cookiesPage.typesBody: This site uses strictly necessary technical cookies for its operation. If you accept all cookies in the banner, functional cookies from the live chat provider Tawk.to LLC (USA) are also enabled to keep the conversation alive. We do not use analytics, advertising or social-media cookies.

cookies.name: alba-cookie-consent
cookies.purpose: Remembers your choice in the cookie banner (accept all, reject non-essential or close).
cookies.retention: Persistent until browser storage is cleared

cookies.name: lead-modal-auto-fired
cookies.purpose: Prevents showing the contact modal more than once per session.
cookies.retention: Until the browser tab is closed

cookies.name: NEXT_LOCALE
cookies.purpose: Remembers the selected language to show the correct site version.

cookies.name: __tawkuuid
cookies.purpose: Anonymously identifies the visitor inside the live chat (only if you accept all cookies).

cookies.name: Tawk_*
cookies.purpose: Keeps the active chat session so the conversation history is not lost.
cookies.retention: Session / until the browser is closed

cookiesPage.manageBody: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies in the banner shown when entering the site. You can also clear cookies and local storage in your browser settings (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Rejecting strictly necessary technical cookies may affect site functionality.
cookiesPage.changesBody: If we add analytics or marketing cookies in the future (for example, Google Analytics), we will update this policy and request your consent through the banner before activating them.
cookiesPage.contactBody: For any question about this Cookie Policy, please email albaventanas@gmail.com.
